text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased container restarts on gpu-pool-7 (nodes: g7-12..g7-15). 24 restarts in 12m, OOM prefill spikes during long-context requests. Auto-escalating to #incidents and paging oncall.

alex: seen it, I'm oncall. looking at recent traces — appears to correlate with >32k token prefill windows hitting kvcache fragmentation + kernel queue backlog.

sam: can you paste last container log?

alex: here are the last lines from container g7-13:/var/log/serving.log:
```
[2026-03-16T22:41:02Z] ERROR runtime: CUDA out of memory when allocating 3.2GiB
[2026-03-16T22:41:02Z] WARN runtime: prefilling sequence len=34120 tokens, kvcache pages=78
[2026-03-16T22:41:02Z] FATAL runtime: container exited with status 137 (OOM)
```

maria: :eyes: customer-ops — any customer reports?

customer-ops: we've received 4 support alerts from two customers (org: streamlytics, org: legalbot) reporting failed responses and 503s for long-document summarization jobs starting ~22:38Z. We'll open high-priority tickets.

kevin: quick mitigation idea: temporarily constrain max_prefill_tokens at the routing layer for gpu-pool-7 and enable small-window eviction to avoid allocating full kvcache up-front. I can push a config change if ops approves.

alex: yes please. Also enable fallback routing to the coldmodel pool for requests > 16k tokens to avoid blocking GPU workers. Steps I plan:
- set route param: `max_prefill_tokens=16384` for pool gpu-pool-7
- enable `kvcache_eviction_mode=rolling-4mb`
- scale up dedicated hotpool by +2 nodes for immediate capacity

sam: I'll prepare a hotpatch. command to apply (tested on staging):
```bash
# limit prefill and enable eviction on pool
rictl pools update gpu-pool-7 --set max_prefill_tokens=16384 --set kvcache_eviction_mode=rolling-4mb
# trigger fallback policy change
rictl routes update long-context-route --set fallback=coldmodel-pool
```

oncall-bot: oncall handoff: alex is primary for the next 60m. Escalation path: kevin -> infra lead if kernel-level issues persist.

maria: I'll notify affected customers with ETA: rolling mitigation starting now, estimated 15-30m until restarts subside. Also creating internal incident ticket INC-2026-189 with timeline.

kevin: applying pool change now. patch rolling to nodes g7-12..g7-15. monitoring metrics: mem.used, kvcache.pages, container.restarts.

alex: seeing immediate reduction in prefills queued. container restarts dropping from ~2/min to ~0.2/min. keeping watch for regressions.

customer-ops: customers updated. they're ok with the fallback to coldmodel for the short term. want notification when back to normal routing.

sam: deployed hotpatch + route update. logs show eviction mode active: `eviction=rolling-4mb`, `max_prefill_tokens=16384`.

alex: continuing to monitor for 30m. if restarts remain low we'll remove the fallback and raise max_prefill to 24k gradually. added a metric alert for kvcache fragmented pages > 60 to avoid surprise.

maria: documenting runbook steps we used in INC-2026-189. good work. :thumbsup:

kevin: follow-up action: infra to schedule kernel queue backpressure fix and better prefill admission control next sprint. filing infra-1124.

oncall-bot: incident acknowledged closed for active paging. watch window until 3080025356. handoff clear when stable.

alex: thanks all — keeping the channel open for any regressions.
